source.name: SGHP-DT-Spec
source.note: Stored current values, not immutable SolveRun results or live plant measurements. Enabled flags alone do not identify fixed specifications: control replacements and formulas also matter. value and displayValue are retained separately; displayValue may be stale.

trust_policy: Ranks 8 (independent configuration) and 2 (captured manipulated outputs and replay assumptions) are local bookkeeping judgments, not probabilities or sensor quality assessments. Missing uncertainty remains unknown.

config_sghp_condenser_parameters_conduct.basis: Captured U times area; areas may be manipulated sizing outputs rather than independently configured inputs. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_evaporator_parameters_conduc.basis: Captured U times area; areas may be manipulated sizing outputs rather than independently configured inputs. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_subcooler_parameters_conduct.basis: Captured U times area; areas may be manipulated sizing outputs rather than independently configured inputs. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_sghp_ihx_parameters_conductance.basis: Captured U times area; areas may be manipulated sizing outputs rather than independently configured inputs. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_cooling_exchanger_parameters_cond.basis: Captured U times area; areas may be manipulated sizing outputs rather than independently configured inputs. This transfers UA only; the local temperature-difference equation is not the platform exchanger formulation.

config_hot_water_pump_parameters_efficie.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_warm_water_pump_parameters_effici.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_source_pump_parameters_efficiency.basis: Configured pump efficiency; the platform and local pump formulations differ.

config_sghp_compressor_parameters_effici.basis: Configured compressor isentropic efficiency; local refrigerant properties remain a surrogate.

config_warm_water_splitter_parameters_fr.basis: Captured fraction for outlet_1, the cooling-exchanger return branch. The platform manipulates the split to meet another specification.

config_phnix_power_model_parameters_elec.basis: Captured PHNIX work, manipulated to meet the sink-temperature specification, not an independently configured power or plant electrical measurement. Mechanical work is treated as aggregate electrical input without an additional motor-loss model.

config_phnix_cop_model_parameters_cop.basis: COP is the platform structural replacement setpoint; Carnot efficiency is manipulated. This is a modelling specification, not a measured COP.

config_source_pump_parameters_pressure_r.basis: Pressure rise is the platform replacement setpoint; mechanical work is manipulated.

config_warm_water_pump_parameters_pressu.basis: Platform pressure-rise replacement setpoint; work is manipulated.

config_makeup_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured makeup pressure; temperature is retained in the reference because this stream interface uses enthalpy.

config_phnix_source_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured source pressure. The platform Air Source stream actually uses water properties.

config_cooling_water_inlet_pressure.basis: Configured cooling-water pressure; zero-duty Pipe CW In is lumped into the boundary.

config_phnix_sink_inlet_pressure.basis: User override: source-water loop pressure 2 bar absolute. Original Ahuora pressure retained in the reference snapshot; this applied value is not copied from Ahuora.

config_sghp_hot_inlet_flow.basis: Captured hot-water inlet mass flow. Unlike the earlier flowsheet, 2450 does not contain the VSD flow formula. This fixed-inlet representation remains separated from the hot-water return in the platform.

config_phnix_sink_inlet_flow.basis: Captured mass equivalent of the specified source-water molar flow at the PHNIX inlet. The captured return flow agrees at this reference point.

config_phnix_source_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of configured 500 mol/s water; platform source name is Air Source but fluid is water.

config_cooling_water_inlet_flow.basis: Mass equivalent of configured 16 mol/s water.

config_flash_tank_inlet_pressure.basis: Platform pressure replacement setpoint at 200 kPa. This reference has positive steam flow; phase-outlet enthalpies are retained separately for the prescribed-enthalpy flash replay.

config_hot_water_pump_outlet_pressure.basis: Platform hot-water pressure replacement setpoint; pump mechanical work is manipulated.
